title: 1.4: Stub popup and service worker
description: Create src/popup/popup.html, popup.ts, popup.css, src/background/service-worker.ts, placeholder icons. Run npm run build and manually verify extension loads in chrome://extensions.

title: 1.2: Build script (copy-assets.mjs)
description: Create scripts/copy-assets.mjs that copies manifest.json, popup.html, popup.css, and icons/ into dist/. Supports --watch mode via chokidar.

title: 1.3: Manifest V3
description: Create manifest.json at repo root with permissions, host_permissions, action popup, and background service worker configuration.

title: 1.1: Repo scaffold (package.json, tsconfig.json, .gitignore)
description: Create package.json with build/watch/test/clean scripts, tsconfig.json targeting ES2022 with module bundler resolution, and extend .gitignore. Run npm install.

title: Phase 5: Polish (icons, README, v0.1.0 tag)
description: Replace placeholder icons with real ones, write README (install/usage/privacy/limits/roadmap/manual test checklist), and tag v0.1.0. Plan: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-05-02-markhive-v1.md (Phase 5).
acceptance_criteria: Real PNG icons present at all three sizes. README covers install + usage + privacy + manual test checklist. git tag v0.1.0 created.

title: Phase 4: Popup UI
description: Build the popup: HTML/CSS shell, wiring (read active tab URL, load settings, send export message, render markdown, trigger download), error toasts mapped to the spec error matrix, and a manual end-to-end pass through the spec checklist. Plan: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-05-02-markhive-v1.md (Phase 4).
acceptance_criteria: Open claude.ai chat -> click toolbar icon -> toggle options -> click Export -> .md file downloads with the expected filename and content. All spec error cases produce the documented toast.

title: Phase 2: Pure core (renderer, slugify, url-parse)
description: Build the pure (chrome-API-free) library: canonical Conversation types, url-parse, slugify, filename builder, and a fixture-tested renderer that handles text/thinking/tool_use/tool_result/artifact/attachment/unknown blocks per the spec dispatch table. TDD throughout. Plan: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-05-02-markhive-v1.md (Phase 2).
acceptance_criteria: All renderer.ts unit tests pass against fixtures in test/fixtures/. No file in src/lib/ imports chrome.* APIs.

title: Phase 3: Claude API + service worker
description: Wire the network layer: claude-api.ts (fetchOrgId + fetchConversation with typed errors), settings.ts (chrome.storage wrapper with defaults + tests using a tiny shim), service worker message routing, and an export-pipeline glue function. Plan: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-05-02-markhive-v1.md (Phase 3).
acceptance_criteria: From the service worker console, sendMessage({kind:'export', chatId:<real uuid>}) returns a 200 + JSON conversation. Settings round-trip through chrome.storage.

title: Phase 1: Project skeleton
description: Stand up the repo so an empty Manifest V3 extension loads cleanly in chrome://extensions. Includes package.json + tsconfig, build pipeline (tsc + asset copy script), manifest.json, stub popup and service worker, placeholder icons, and a manual load verification. Plan: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-05-02-markhive-v1.md (Phase 1).
acceptance_criteria: Extension loads as unpacked from dist/. Toolbar icon shows. Popup opens and logs 'Markhive popup ready'. Service worker logs 'Markhive worker ready'.

title: Markhive v1: Chrome extension exporting Claude conversations to Markdown
description: Ship a Manifest V3 Chrome extension that exports the open claude.ai conversation to a local Markdown file with configurable inclusion of thinking, tool inputs, and tool results.
